topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the pages, hidden deep within a drawer, each sheet filled with worlds I didn't know existed. Every word, a mirror, yet a distorted one that twisted the echoes of our life into something unrecognizable. The characters, so vivid, danced on the lines with secrets woven into their names, stories I never knew I had. I walked through the silence of our home, the walls whispering back, or maybe it was just my heart. The air feels different now, laden with tales untold, a narrative I didn't choose to read, yet here I stand, paper trembling in my hands.
